heading: Dinner's at 7. The band's on at 8. Aqua-aerobics is at 9 tomorrow. One app finds all of it.
subhead: A hotel isn't one venue — it's a dozen: dining, a stage, meeting rooms, a gym, a pool, gardens, wedding spaces. Audeohost-Events is the single guest-facing map across all of it, without stepping into what happens inside any specific room.

beatStrip: This is what Audeohost-Events was built for — not just sport, and not just a hotel's headline event, but a diary of events for customers to look forward to.
